disposition_reason: The original V1 sentence-decoding task is ordered, but the registered neural-only export has no recovered matching published numeric baseline. The headline MEG CER of 29% includes the language model. Current source defaults also differ from the paper training recipe and split description; a successful local transcript score cannot establish a same-task win.

source_paper.title: Non-invasive decoding of typed sentences from human brain activity

evidence.locator: Fig. 2e–h; Brain2Qwerty ablations; Methods: preprocessing, train/validation/test splits, Evaluation/CER
evidence.supports: Original V1 modalities, ablated neural-only versus language-assisted systems, and sentence-level CER target.
Scores the presented true sentence, merges duplicate MEG recording IDs, and averages sentence CER within subject then across subjects.
Pinned current source uses 300 epochs, batch64, learning rate5e-5, split seed1; comment explicitly identifies a changed learning rate.
Participant/event cleaning and connected-component TF-IDF similarity clustering with keystroke-weighted greedy split allocation.
V1 links the source paper and SpanishBCBL; V2 data are separately embargoed.
Historical scorer is a presented-sentence export implementation; it explicitly disclaims original reference competence and scientific qualification.

target.description: Predict V1 sentence characters from keystroke-aligned EEG or MEG. Match the paper Conv+Trans ablation for the registered neural-only condition; full Brain2Qwerty with N-gram correction is a separate source condition.

dataset.description: SpanishBCBL V1 is identified by the author release. The registration pins revision88f9096c6ce3a3fb17cc7b8e3131ff7f96da5684, but exact paper-era recording/event payload equivalence has not been established.

cohort.description: Fig.2 reports20 EEG and19 MEG participants. Author export merges S18→S1, S14→S4, S10/S21→S5. The complete original modality-specific recording/session and sentence roster remains unbound.

split.description: Recover the exact original fixed-seed sentence-cluster train/validation/test membership. Paper describes80/10/10 agglomerative TF-IDF clustering; pinned code builds similarity-connected components and greedily targets keystroke counts. Equal ratios alone do not prove identical heldout sentences.

inputs.description: V1 neural-only condition supplies0.5-second EEG/MEG windows around known keystroke timing and approved participant/sensor metadata. No reference sentence, typed character, language-model rescoring, V2 recordings or added calibration labels may enter inference.

preprocessing.description: Paper specifies0.1–20Hz filtering,50Hz resampling,−0.2 to+0.3s windows, baseline correction and robust scaling. Resolve current extractor baseline conventions, typed versus intended targets, cleaning and training-default changes against the paper recipe before admission.

metric.description: CER is character Levenshtein edits divided by reference sentence length. The pinned export compares predictions with true/presented sentences; WER is secondary and cannot replace the source CER.

aggregation.description: Average sentence CER within each source participant, then equally across participants, separately for EEG and MEG; source export reports subject-level SEM. Do not pool characters or merge modalities into an easier score.

comparison.primary_metric: V1 neural-only Conv+Trans CER, by modality

published_baseline.description: Matching Fig.2 Conv+Trans aggregate CER not recovered. Published full-system MEG29% and EEG65% are contextual results, not neural-only baselines.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No author-model rerun or original-split agreement. Use the original V1 Conv+Trans recipe after resolving source-default differences; do not substitute a locally authored decoder.

minimum_effect.rationale: Determine a CER reduction that changes sentence recovery meaningfully, using source participant variation and full sentence errors; no numerical margin is supported yet.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired participant-level uncertainty for candidate-minus-author CER after fixing each modality and the original test sentences; account for shared sentences and model-seed variation.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Biological participant; repeated sessions and sentence repeats remain nested.
uncertainty.rationale: Fig.2 identifies participants as biological replicates. The final interval/decision rule and replication count are not fixed.

paper_win_requires: Recover original Conv+Trans paper score and validate the exact modality-specific person/session/sentence roster and split.
Demonstrate improved original CER versus both the published same-condition score and a competent author rerun under matched declared access/resources.
Do not compare neural-only outputs to the language-assisted29% headline, count alias recordings as independent people, or claim a paper win on a new sentence split.
Freeze the decoder, preprocessing, thresholds and all selection decisions before one protected final evaluation.

current_sota.description: No separately source-verified current-SOTA comparison has been established.

episode.improvement_loop: After source recovery, iterate V1 neural decoder changes using original training and validation sentences only; report validation CER by modality and record all attempts.
episode.candidate_freeze: Seal code, model, preprocessing, modality, source roster, split, access/resource budgets and selection rule before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Use the identical original test sentence/person panel and export CER route with protected references; a newly created split is an extension.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep published Conv+Trans score, independently rerun author Conv+Trans score and full-system language-model score separate. Current source defaults require reconciliation.

blocking_issues: Paper-era split membership and complete modality-specific empirical roster not authenticated.
Current300-epoch/batch64/lr5e-5 defaults differ from paper100-epoch/batch128/lr1e-4 recipe; intended versus typed target conventions need reconciliation.
No matched author rerun, protected model execution, justified effect, final uncertainty rule, or fixed episode budgets.

legacy.notes: Retain transcript evaluator as calibration only. It validates complete supplied panel coverage but explicitly does not establish authentic population, original decoder competence, or paper reproduction.
